subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.----INFO.DY.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-27 — the section examining how by-the-end-of-the-sixties everyone-had-rediscovered-Marx in the so-called black revolution. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'by the end of the sixties, everyone had rediscovered Marx (which later would lead to scientific socialism, as a term that "implied not a complete surrender" to western ideology). The realness of this phenomenon cannot be ignored... the gradual adaptation of western informational dynamics by the so-called black revolutionaries cannot be simply dismissed as normal within the multi-informational state of things (source transfer).' The crossing diagrams how world-expansion-principle structurally meets information-dynamics at the sixties-end Marxism-adoption scale: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's actual information output). WO-EXP-PRI sits on the right with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY sits at the left end of the main line as partner-axis. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) runs down-left from the main line; INFO-TRNS (information transference) and DOC (documentation) branch from T-C-IMP, and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) hangs from INFO-TRNS. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) descends from the main line, with IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) branching from it. MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) descends from the main line near the subject; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) hangs from MT-INTR, and POST (postulation) branches from AF-DY.
